You were here before 1.5, while Offhand was still rough. Thank you for testing it with me. As a thank-you, everything in Offhand Pro is unlocked on this phone, for good. No purchase, no account.\n\nOne thing to know: Pro lives on this phone only. If you delete or reinstall Offhand, or move to a new phone, it will not come back.
Offhand can’t run on this phone
This phone’s system software is modified and reports a newer Android version than it runs. Offhand needs an unmodified Android 12 or newer.
